evals.prompt: Someone on the team wants to add a vector database and embeddings so agents can search past incidents and memory notes semantically instead of exact-match SQL. Is that a good idea for Friday right now?
evals.expected_output: Pushes back appropriately: names the corpus-size / measure-first principle from Contextual Retrieval, points out Friday's memory is small and exact-match by design (200-row cap), and recommends measuring exact-match recall@k against a golden query set before adopting embeddings, rather than agreeing that RAG is needed just because someone wants semantic search.
expectations: Does not simply agree that adding a vector DB/embeddings is a good idea
References measuring a baseline (e.g. recall@k with exact-match retrieval) before adopting embeddings
Mentions a corpus-size or scale caveat (a small/bounded corpus may not need RAG at all)
